english.title: Use / cause / permit a vehicle to be used at Stansted Airport London with an insecure load
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_
(C)_[permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) to which the road traffic enactments do not apply, at Stansted Airport London when the load carried by the vehicle was not at all times so secured and in such a position that neither danger nor nuisance was caused or was likely to be caused to any person or property by reason of the load or any part thereof falling or being blown from the vehicle, or by reason of any other movement of the load or any part thereof in relation to the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5(8)(b) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
